name: ai-skills
title_zh: 一套技能同时喂给 Claude、Cursor
tagline_zh: 装一次，四个终端都能用。数据库、消息、研究、TTS、DevOps。
tagline_en: Install once, run on four CLIs. Databases, messaging, research, TTS, DevOps, Google Workspace—no more hunting.
desc_en: 24 cross-platform agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex & Gemini CLI — databases, messaging, research, TTS, DevOps, and Google Workspace
why_zh: 它不绑死任何一家生态，把 24 个技能做成同一套跨平台协议。
why_en: It refuses to lock you into one vendor—24 skills speak the same cross-platform protocol. Tune one in Claude Code, switch to.
limit_zh: 只覆盖这 24 个技能列出的领域（数据库、消息、研究、TTS、DevOps、Google Workspace）。
limit_en: Covers only the 24 listed domains (DB, messaging, research, TTS, DevOps, Google Workspace). Requires local CLI tools & API keys; skills orchestrate.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: One skill pack for Claude, Cursor, Codex & Gemini CLI
